_doc: Contagion playbook for Agent 6 (the pre-market News Brain). Keys under 'sectors' MATCH watchlist.json sector names; the brain joins them to symbols at runtime, so this file never duplicates (or drifts from) the symbol list. 'bellwethers' = global/India names whose news reads across to that NSE sector. 'thesis' = the analyst read-across logic given to Claude as a prior. 'negative_cues'/'positive_cues' = lowercase substrings for the deterministic (no-API-key) fallback matcher. 'macro_drivers' = cross-sector forces (crude, rates, INR, China, flows). Edit freely — no code change needed. Truth-first: every relationship here is a real, documented read-across, not a guess.

IT.thesis: Indian IT services revenue tracks global enterprise tech budgets. Accenture is THE lead indicator: it reports ~3 weeks before TCS/Infosys and explicitly guides on demand and bookings. A weak Accenture print or guide-down, or 'IT spending slowdown / discretionary cuts' headlines, are a sector-wide NEGATIVE read-across for INFY, TCS, HCLTECH, TECHM, WIPRO. A weaker rupee (USD/INR up) is a margin POSITIVE for exporters. H-1B/visa tightening is NEGATIVE.

Metals.thesis: Ferrous/non-ferrous names (TATASTEEL, HINDALCO, HINDZINC, VEDL, GRAVITA) are price-takers on global commodity prices. China stimulus or property-sector support lifts LME base metals = POSITIVE. China demand weakness, steel dumping, or new US/EU tariffs = NEGATIVE. A stronger dollar is a headwind for metals.

Mining.thesis: COALINDIA earnings hinge on volumes, e-auction premiums and power-sector offtake. Strong power demand / heatwave and high e-auction premiums = POSITIVE. Falling global coal prices compress e-auction realisations = NEGATIVE; high monsoon can dent dispatch.

Energy.thesis: Split read-across. For OMC/refiner BPCL: crude UP squeezes marketing margins = NEGATIVE, crude DOWN = POSITIVE; strong Singapore GRMs = POSITIVE. For RELIANCE (integrated: O2C + retail + Jio): crude is mixed; the swing factors are GRMs, telecom ARPU/Jio, and retail. OPEC supply cuts lift crude.

Pharma.thesis: SUNPHARMA, DRREDDY earn heavily from US generics. USFDA import alerts / Form 483 / warning letters on a specific plant are NEGATIVE for that name. US generic price erosion is a sector headwind; drug shortages and ANDA approvals are POSITIVE. Mostly name-specific (plant-level), so attribute to the right symbol.

Auto.thesis: MARUTI, BAJAJ-AUTO, HEROMOTOCO, EICHERMOT move on monthly wholesale/retail volumes, rural demand (2-wheelers), input/chip availability and festive season. Strong monthly numbers / good monsoon = POSITIVE. Chip shortage, demand slowdown, steep input-cost inflation = NEGATIVE.

Banking.thesis: HDFCBANK, ICICIBANK, AXISBANK, SBIN, KOTAKBANK, INDUSINDBK. RBI rate CUTS compress near-term NIMs but lift credit demand and treasury gains (bond prices up) = net mildly POSITIVE for system; a HIKE/liquidity tightening pressures the sector. Rising NPAs/slippages or RBI restrictions on a specific bank are NEGATIVE for that name. Strong credit growth and falling slippages are POSITIVE.

NBFC.thesis: BAJFINANCE, BAJAJFINSV, SHRIRAMFIN are funding-cost sensitive. Falling bond yields / rate cuts lower borrowing cost = POSITIVE. RBI tightening risk-weights on consumer/unsecured loans, or higher funding costs, = NEGATIVE. AUM growth and benign credit costs are POSITIVE.

Insurance.thesis: SBILIFE, HDFCLIFE move on APE growth, VNB margin and regulation. Adverse tax/GST changes on premiums or surrender-value rules = NEGATIVE. Strong APE/VNB and favourable regulation = POSITIVE.

Telecom.thesis: BHARTIARTL (and equipment maker HFCL) move on tariff hikes (ARPU up = POSITIVE), subscriber adds, AGR/spectrum dues (NEGATIVE), and 5G/fibre capex (POSITIVE for HFCL gear orders).

Defence.thesis: BEL, HAL, DATAPATTNS, DCXINDIA are order-book driven. New MoD orders, indigenisation push, higher defence capex, and export approvals = POSITIVE. Order deferrals/cancellations or budget cuts = NEGATIVE. Geopolitical tension typically lifts the basket.

Defence Electronics.thesis: DIXON is an EMS/electronics-manufacturing play. PLI incentives, new client/anchor wins, and 'China+1' shift = POSITIVE. Global consumer-electronics demand and the semis cycle (Micron/Nvidia/Broadcom) color sentiment. Component shortages or PLI rollback = NEGATIVE.

FMCG.thesis: HINDUNILVR, ITC, NESTLEIND, BRITANNIA hinge on rural demand, monsoon, and input costs (palm oil, wheat, milk). Good monsoon + falling input costs + volume growth = POSITIVE. Input-cost inflation or rural weakness = NEGATIVE. ITC additionally moves on cigarette taxation.

Cement.thesis: GRASIM, ULTRACEMCO move on cement realisations, regional price hikes, demand (housing+infra), and energy (petcoke/coal) costs. Price hikes + strong demand + lower fuel cost = POSITIVE. Price wars / weak demand / fuel inflation = NEGATIVE.

Utilities.thesis: POWERGRID earns regulated returns — a defensive bond-proxy. Falling yields/rate cuts = POSITIVE (re-rating); rising yields = NEGATIVE. New transmission project awards and strong power demand are POSITIVE.

Power.thesis: POWERINDIA (grid/transmission & industrial automation) is order-book and capex driven. New T&D/grid orders, electrification and data-centre power demand = POSITIVE. Order deferrals or margin pressure = NEGATIVE.

Infra.thesis: LT moves on order inflows and the govt capex cycle (a record order book / strong inflows = POSITIVE). ADANIPORTS moves on cargo volumes and acquisitions. Govt capex cuts, award slowdowns or group-level overhang = NEGATIVE.

Consumer.thesis: TITAN is jewellery-led: stable/rising gold with strong studded demand and store adds = POSITIVE, sharp gold spikes hurt volumes. ASIANPAINT is crude-input (crude down = margin POSITIVE) and demand-led; new competition (e.g. Grasim paints) is a structural NEGATIVE.

Exchange.thesis: MCX (commodities) and BSE (cash+derivatives) earn on volumes. SEBI tightening of F&O/expiry rules or STT/transaction-charge hikes = NEGATIVE (volume hit). Rising turnover, new products and expiry-day strength = POSITIVE.

US markets overnight (S&P/Nasdaq, future.logic: A sharp overnight US selloff (esp. Nasdaq/tech) sets a RISK-OFF tone for NSE open and hits IT/tech-linked names hardest. Strong US close = supportive. Always check US futures pre-open.

Brent crude.logic: Crude UP = NEGATIVE for OMCs (BPCL) and for India's import bill/inflation (broad headwind); paint/FMCG input costs rise. Crude DOWN = broad POSITIVE. India imports ~85% of oil, so crude is the single biggest macro swing factor.

USD/INR.logic: Rupee WEAKER (USD/INR up) = POSITIVE for exporters (IT, Pharma) via margins, NEGATIVE for importers (OMC, metals buying USD inputs) and adds imported inflation. Sharp rupee depreciation also pressures FII flows.

US Fed / US 10Y yield.logic: Falling US yields / dovish Fed = POSITIVE for rate-sensitives (NBFC, Banks, POWERGRID bond-proxy) and supports EM/FII inflows. Rising yields / hawkish Fed = NEGATIVE, pressures rate-sensitives and can trigger FII outflows.

RBI policy (repo, CRR, liquidity).logic: Rate cut / liquidity easing = POSITIVE for credit-linked demand (Auto, NBFC) and bond gains; near-term bank NIM compression. Hike/tightening = NEGATIVE for rate-sensitives.

India VIX spike.logic: A VIX spike (>=70th pctile / level >=18) signals RISK-OFF; size down, defined-risk only. Handled by the existing regime engine — the brain should flag it but not double-count.

FII / FPI flows.logic: Heavy FII selling = broad NEGATIVE, hits high-FII-ownership sectors (private banks, IT) hardest. Strong inflows = broad POSITIVE. Watch the prior-day cash-market FII/DII provisional figures.

China stimulus / China demand.logic: China stimulus or property support lifts LME base metals = POSITIVE for TATASTEEL/HINDALCO/HINDZINC/VEDL. China weakness / steel dumping = NEGATIVE.

Semiconductor cycle (Micron/Nvidia/TSMC/.logic: Strong AI/semis demand and capex support EMS (DIXON) and AI-server names (NETWEB) sentiment; a semis downturn or memory-price crash is NEGATIVE for the electronics/hardware complex.
